newsitem.title: FRANCE: French CFDT union joins Oct 17 rail strike call.
newsitem.headline: French CFDT union joins Oct 17 rail strike call.

text.p: France's Socialist CFDT union said on Wednesday it had called a national one-day strike at the SNCF state railways on October 17 in unison with the Communist-led CGT union.
"After a meeting of national and regional executives, we have voted unanimously for a strike on October 17," the head of the CFDT railworkers federation, Bruno Dalberto, told Reuters.

The call follows Tuesday's call by the Communist-led CGT union for a day of action on October 17, the same day as a public service strike, to protest against staff cuts and a planned break-up of the SNCF into two organisations.
On Monday, seven public sector unions agreed to make October 17 a day of protest and demonstrations against feared job losses and pay freezes in the civil service.
Teaching unions have called a 24-hour strike for September 30, to protest against budget reductions and staff shortages.
